stage: One bounded Bank full-H CV2 step-size extension; pilot only
step_size_convention: canonical h, drift -h P gradient, noise covariance 2h P; values are actual h, not legacy 2h
initialization: Every independent replica starts at the unchanged Bank mode; original independent replica/iteration/purpose RNG and without-replacement subset kernel
references: Reuse unchanged passed reference pools, stored scoring draws and 128 projections; no new reference sampling or preprocessing
failure_rule: Unchanged: nonfinite proposal or standardized radius >100 sqrt(d) permanently fails the lane; any failed replica invalidates complete ensemble accuracy from its first failure onward
baseline: Recorded full-H CV1 h=0.05, K=2048, seeds 187000/187001. Other original valid full-H CV1 checkpoints define the comparison frontier. ULA is reported separately as the exact-gradient control.

candidate_rule.eligibility: Both screening runs complete K=2048 with zero failed replicas; mean SW2 and mean variance NRMSE at K=2048 are each no greater than the baseline on BOTH references; no recorded valid CV1 full-H configuration/checkpoint simultaneously dominates candidate SW2, variance NRMSE and warm wall-clock on BOTH references
candidate_rule.ranking: Among eligible candidates, minimize the maximum of four accuracy ratios (SW2 and variance NRMSE for each reference) to the fixed CV1 baseline. Tie: lower mean warm wall-clock, then smaller h.
candidate_rule.cost_interpretation: Eligibility allows an accuracy/time tradeoff; it is not evidence of less time to matched accuracy. Report cold and warm time ratios separately. Historical baseline timings and new process timings are exploratory, not a paired benchmark.
candidate_rule.validation: Run the selected h on all four predeclared fresh pilot seeds, without retuning. Require zero failed replicas, complete K=2048 and the same two-reference accuracy and non-dominance rules on four-seed means. Compare to historical baseline descriptively; no cross-seed superiority inference.
candidate_rule.no_fallback: If validation fails, do not try a second h. Stop and report limitations.

stop_rule: One extension only. No new h, longer K, larger batch, new reference or automatic held-out run. No eligible candidate or failed fresh-seed validation ends this extension. A qualified candidate is submitted for final configuration freeze review, not claimed universally stable.
cost: Original setup-inclusive wall-clock definitions: anchor optimization, actual GPU/cache/metric/state setup and sampling; attributed first-use compilation added for cold. Functional/scoring/backup costs excluded. All per-batch times, no division by replicas.
amendment_reason: Four original CV2 failures reproduced at iteration 396 after repeated high-leverage minibatches. Extend h downward without altering original grid, target, reference, failure criteria or observations.
